label: Mixed CCVS and non-CCVS tasks — monitoring table must have exactly 1 row

project_meta.principal_contractor: Robertson's Remedial and Painting Pty Ltd
project_meta.pcbu_name: Robertson's Remedial and Painting Pty Ltd

inference.hrcw_category: WHS Reg 2017 Sch 3 cl.2 — Construction work at height — risk of fall >2m

tasks.scope: Deliver materials, set up site office, establish exclusion zones
hazards: Struck by vehicle — delivery truck movement in site area
Manual handling — muscle strain from unloading
controls: Traffic management plan in place before deliveries start
Mechanical aids used for loads over 20kg
stop_work: 🛑 STOP WORK if: delivery area not clear of persons
admin: Site induction completed by all workers before starting

tasks.scope: Use scissor lift to inspect and mark defects above 4m
hazards: Fall from height — EWP tip or guardrail failure
controls: ⚠️ HOLD POINT — CCVS WAH-H6: EWP pre-start checklist completed and signed
Minimum clearance 3m from overhead lines — spotter required
Guardrails at full height — no leaning over
hold_points: ⚠️ HOLD POINT — Pre-start checklist signed before EWP use
stop_work: 🛑 STOP WORK if: wind speed exceeds manufacturer limit
🛑 STOP WORK if: overhead line clearance cannot be maintained
admin: Ground conditions checked — level and firm
ppe: Full-body harness — anchored to EWP anchor point

responsibility.SUP: Verify pre-start, manage overhead line exclusion
responsibility.WKR: Complete pre-start, wear harness, report faults

monitoring.critical_control: Confirm EWP pre-start checklist signed before each shift use

tasks.scope: Prepare substrate and apply liquid membrane to all balcony decks
hazards: Chemical skin contact — uncured membrane causes sensitisation
Slip on membrane during application — fall on same level
controls: Chemical-resistant gloves worn at all times during application
Wet area barriers erected — no foot traffic on membrane for minimum 4 hours
stop_work: 🛑 STOP WORK if: rain forecast within cure time window
admin: Wet film thickness checked during application

responsibility.WKR: Apply per spec, wear chemical PPE
